challenge: Sunny, calm Sunday in New Buffalo, near 69°F by 3 PM with the wind dropping off. After yesterday's upper day and a 37% recovery, keep it an easy active-recovery day ahead of Tuesday's labs: a long walk, light core and mobility, nothing hard.
constraint: Labs are Tue Oct 27, 10:20 AM. Keep training moderate (nothing to failure) Oct 25–26; no creatine the morning of Oct 27.
items: Easy 60 min walk (beach or trail), early-to-mid afternoon (~65–69°F, light wind)
Light core: 3 x 30 sec plank, 2 x 12 dead bugs, 2 x 10 bird dogs
15 min mobility (hips, hamstrings, upper back, shoulders)
30 min easy kayak if the lake is calm after 3 PM; dress for cold water (optional)
